body:
A resource pack that transforms Minecraft with a darker, more mysterious style.
deep shadows, muted tones, and subtle details to create an immersive dark theme.

🔹 Features:

Dark-themed textures and UI.

Clean, minimalistic style without unnecessary details.

Perfect for survival, adventure, and Dark Fantasy–inspired modpacks.


🌑 For players who enjoy a more atmospheric and shadowy Minecraft experience.
